nom: Vichy Normaderm S.O.S Acne Rescue Spot Corrector

avis.texte: As someone who has struggled with acne for the past 20 years, this stuff works! I do no react well to benzoyl peroxide so I gave this a try and it is now a staple for me. The moment I feel a pimple coming on, I treat it with this cream. I even keep one in my car. Can use it as a cream during the day, or thick layer overnight. The pimple will be gone before it even comes out. I love this stuff.

My husband is bald. He developed large rashy acne spots on each side of his head from wearing a hat in the heat all day. This cleared it up in one week. It went from super angry red inflammation to perfectly clear. He applied twice a day.

This is a wonderful gel that gets rid of the window, I apply it directly to acne, irritation goes away, it does not dry out the skin too much, it contains salicylic acid, which works great on acne, I recommend it for use

i really liked this product! i have used it for a little while now for the first time and i definitely liked it. it helped a lot (i have started getting compliments from people i see every day saying that my skin has cleared up a lot). it's super easy to apply. mine is just about gone; i only have like one or two more uses to get out of it. and the price too… super cheap! love it!
Soooo amazing!!! And so worth it! It may seem expensive but definitely last bc a small dot goes such a long way!!! I put this in under my pimple patch and pimple dries, doesn't scar or anything!!!
This smells really unpleasant and does not work. I have used it for months now and not one blemish was cleared. Tea tree oil works better than this.

avis.titre: A must have for your face
avis.texte: Just had to share my excitement about the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S Acne Rescue Spot Corrector. This stuff is like an acne-fighting superhero! 🦸‍♀️ With a solid 10% sulfur punch, it dries up active blemishes and seriously puts new ones on notice. No more settling for less – it's oil-free, so it takes down those blemishes without a fuss. And you know that pesky blemish that popped up right before the big day? This little gem shrinks 'em down like magic. The best part? It's got niacinamide for that soothing touch, giving your skin a healing boost. Plus, it's lightweight and sinks in fast, so no heavy, sticky feeling. Sensitive skin peeps, don't worry – this is your friend too. Dermatologist-approved and non-comedogenic, it's the real deal. And the results? In just a week*, my blemishes were like, "See ya!" Size reduced and overall skin looking way better. Cheers to Vichy Normaderm for the rescue!

I was skeptical of a spot treatment product because I though I would just spend money on an all over face product that I could put over breakouts… BUT WOW. This concentrated product made with sulfur which is apparently great for targeting postules (which I get during my menstrual cycle) shrunk two huge postules within a day, whereas they usually burst and scar! The trick is to start when you feel a little bump coming up. Treat it before it grows to minimize the chance that it will grow pus and eventually pop, leaving a scar. My tip is: use micellar water on a cotton pad gently on the area.. then apply the spot treatment. Do this up to 3 times daily until the blemish shrinks.
Cleared up my acne and marks within two weeks , I have extremely happy with this product range. It has been hard to find a product for my skin type as it is combination and sensitive.
I only need a little bit on problem areas. It clears things up quickly without drying things excessively.

I want to like this, but the smell is very intense. I put it on at night and can still smell it in the morning and that sulfur smell is very overwhelming. I feel bad for the low rating, and I know sulfur is what helps with the zits in the product and should expect the scent, but it might just be too much for me. I like Vichy products a lot in general though. It worked okay for drying up zits though.
I love this product, before I tried many and this one removed old acne spots and at the same time controlled my acne

I bought this about 1 week ago and I already see results! I put this on my pimples and they are visibly reduced in 2 days . I do have very oily skin and get random pimples but they always come in 5 or 6 at a time . I put this spot treatment on them and by the next morning they are drying out and going down. I am 34 years old and this stuff works better than anything I have ever tried in my life ! I think it's bc of the sulfur that's in it . We have a place where I live and there is a river with sulfur in it and every time I went there my face would clear up so I am assuming that is the ingredient in this stuff that makes it work so well! I will always continue to buy this stuff !! It's a miracle treatment!

I have tried sulfur mask and wash it off after 10 minutes but I love this because you can use it during night time or even day I just prefer the night time and let me tell you that I started to see a big difference. My acne and scars were really bad because of pregnancy and hormones and finding this was just awesome. I'm definitely going to keep buying this product.

The product is worth the subtle sulfur smell! But, be aware that it does have that scent to it. It seems to work quicker as a spot treatment than what I've experienced with LRP Effaclar duo. It is easy to apply, and did not cause added sensitivity for me. 4 stars because that scent is not a good one, ha.

First I have very oily skin & large pores since I was a preteen. I'm now in my early 40s. I have battled acne all my life until around my mid 30s. The oil & pores haven't changed, just alot less acne. I get the occasional big one, & some small ones now & again. This stuff works wonders for me. I can't even belive it. I've tried so many products over the years & this by far works like a charm. Now I am allergic to sulfur.. so why did I even try it? Why not, my acne has done horrible nasty messes toy skin so it can't be much worsen right. So I tried it one 1 zit at first just to see. Bam it was gone the next day. I can say however for me I can't put it on the same zit more then twice in a row or my skin will be super dry around it. But by then my zit is already gone & healing. I had never heard of sulfur acne medicine before so I was astonished & wish I had had this back when I was younger & needed more. It may not work for everyone, but it was a win for me.

I have been using this for months, and it is utterly useless. Aside from emitting a stale fart smell, it has no purpose. I should have discontinued use a long time ago but I wanted to fully test it and review it.

avis.titre: When other acne solutions aren't working
avis.texte: Try sulfur! It's the only thing other than the microdart patches that works for my acne and this formula is great. I use this overnight and my big bumps go flat, I love it!

avis.titre: Finally a spot corrector I like
avis.texte: I have had not such great experiences with spot correctors. I can't use benzoyl peroxide as it gives me hives. And the salicylic acid ones never seem to work for me. But the pink sulfur dip ones can't be worn during the day- this one can! I can do this one day or night, and it really does work. Does it make zits go away overnight? No. But it does significantly reduce them to manageable levels if used the way it suggests. I put this on the affected area 2-3x a day as that is what the instructions say. At night I put it on before bed. I really like it and it has a tiny bit of the smell of sulfur, but it's not overwhelming at all. I am sensitive to smells and I can't smell this after applying.

Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with this spot corrector. I was able to use this product a few times! I felt like this made my skin clearer and it was a relatively quick process that my blemishes cleared up! It is important to me to use skincare products with dermatologist-grade active ingredients because I feel like they work better. The only thing I was not crazy fond of was the smell. My favorite result I noticed after using this spot corrector was that my skin looked better after using it. I would recommend this as a spot treatment!

I used this almost daily for a few weeks. I did not notice any major changes on the small occasional spots that I would get. I'm sure this may work great for others but I didn't notice any change for myself. I would use this twice a day morning and at night before bed. At night I would put larger amounts sometimes and leave a white dot vs rubbing it in clear. It does rub clear which I love and doesn't have any smells. The precision needle tip is great as well to use the minimum amount required. This product was received through the Stellar Product Testing Panel

I received the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector through the Stellar Product Testing Panel. This product is pure magic. I had a few blemishes that appeared one night. I popped on the product and by morning, most my blemishes were gone. I only had to use one time! & the ones that were still there, were noticeably smaller. Now in this new era of mask wearing, I am getting lots of new blemishes almost daily. So this product has definitely been a game changer. I will definitely be re-purchasing this product and urge you to do the same!
I used this product for about a week and a half. It's helped with 2 blemishes I've been very annoyed with! They're subtly and slowly fading but getting there. Thanks stellar panel!

I used this spot corrector 3-4 times a week for about 3 weeks. I think that it worked well and I'm starting to see very slight results. My only complaint is that the smell had a strong sulfur odor. I will say, I am pregnant, so that could contribute to my sensitivity. My husband didn't really notice a smell. I did receive this product through Stellar Product Testing Panel.

I was given the VICHY Normaderm S.O.S Acne Rescue Spot Corrector to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel, and am extremely impressed with how well it has worked for my acne prone / sensitive skin! As of late, ok - I'm blaming 2020 stress & holiday feasting, my skin absolutely erupted, complete with a resurgence of my painful & itchy cystic acne. So, this product arrived just in time, for a new start in 2021. It has really reset my skin's tone, texture, & cleared up my acne, specifically around the cheek / jaw area & chest. It has become an honored staple in my nighttime routine. A real added bonus, it absolutely doesn't dry my skin out -- a real plus for all acne sufferers. You can use this sparingly as it doesn't take much product for great results. It is fragrance free w/ the main ingredient being 10% Sulfur -- which really packs a punch, it cleared up my most stubborn breakouts, w/ no residual scaring. I highly recommend this product for those who struggle with sensitive skin, stubborn / reoccurring breakouts, acne scarring...etc.

I got this Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector just in time as I have terrible Maskne (acne brought on from wearing a mask all day). it comes out a pale yellow but rubs in clear. I like how it doesn't leave a big discolored spot on my face like others I have used. The next morning my huge blemish was a third of the size it was before going to bed. This blemish cream does not smell bad. It did not dry out my skin which is nice. I would recommend this to my friends for sure! I like how the ingredients are Dermatologist Tested. This makes me feel better about what I am putting on my face. I received this product as part of the Steller Product Testing Panel

Very happy to have received this product, especially during the times of "mask-ne!" My chin tends to break out after wearing masks all day so this was a great product to try. Thanks to Stellar Product Testing Panel for the opportunity to try it out. I tried Vichy and noticed that it worked pretty quickly. Unlike other acne products it didn't dry out the skin around my blemish, it just dried out the blemish itself, which is fabulous. I think the tradeoff is that it does take a little longer to work but not having peel skin all around was a definite plus. I'd buy it again!

avis.titre: Easy to Apply, Cystic Acne Shrunk Overnight
avis.texte: Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector was easy to use and apply, and my cystic acne shrunk. The tip is small, so it's easy to get just a tiny dab out. I squeezed the ointment directly onto my zit, then spread it out using the tip of the lid. So, I didn't have any mess on my hand or any oil from my fingers on my face. I placed this on my cystic acne once a day, whenever it popped up, over a week or so, and each one noticeably shrunk overnight. I received this product free to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel, but the opinions and experiences are my own.

I was so excited to try this spot corrector when it arrived because I have some random but embarrassing blemishes that pop out periodically, even as an adult. I put a dab on each of my blemishes before bed that night and, went to bed while I waited for the miracle to happen! I may have had unrealistic expectations, but I hoped that it would work instantly or overnight. When I woke up, I was diappointed to see that my blemishes had not disappeared. I kept at it though and followed the instructions. I used it twice per day and, just like magic, after 3 days - it worked! Gone! And, as an added bonus, my skin didn't dry out either! Thanks Stellar Product Testing Panel for the opportunity to try this product!

avis.titre: Great Acne Solution for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I have been using Vichy Laboratoires' Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector for a few weeks now and I absolutely love it. I have very sensitive skin that is easily irritated. Most over the counter acne medications dry my skin out making it red, itchy, and inflamed. To top it off, it takes days before I can see my acne flare-ups diminish. Fortunately, Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector breaks the mold on all fronts. I fully expected it to take about a week to see a change in my acne. It only took one night. One night and the blemish was gone. I was and still am amazed. Because I was only using the product one night at a time it did not irritate my skin at all. For the sake of this review, I decided to try using this product twice a day for the past week on the same spots. And I am happy to report that my skin is still not irritated at all. A huge thank you to Vichy Laboratoires and the Stellar Product Testing Panel for sending me the Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector to try. I will definitely be buying more once my trial product runs out.

I was given the VICHY Normaderm S.O.S Acne Rescue Spot Corrector to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel, and am extremely impressed with how well it has worked for my acne prone / sensitive skin! As of late, ok - I'm blaming 2020 stress & holiday feasting, my skin absolutely erupted, complete with a resurgence of my painful & itchy cystic acne. So, this product arrived just in time, for a new start in 2021. It has really reset my skin's tone, texture, & cleared up my acne, specifically around the cheek / jaw area & chest. It has become an honored staple in my nighttime routine. A real added bonus, it absolutely doesn't dry my skin out -- a real plus for all acne sufferers. You can use this sparingly as it doesn't take much product for great results. It is fragrance free w/ the main ingredient being 10% Sulfur -- which really packs a punch, it cleared up my most stubborn breakouts, w/ no residual scaring. It also cleared up a reoccurring breakout on my son's chin, gently, at 19mos. I highly recommend this product for those who struggle with sensitive skin, stubborn / reoccurring breakouts, acne scarring...etc.

avis.titre: Good tool to keep in skincare toolbox
avis.texte: After receiving the product from the Stellar Product Testing panel, I used this at night with my usual skin care routine to help combat pesky acne spots. I only used once at night because I didn't want to dry out my skin. It did help bring up any painfully buried spots and dry up whiteheads overnight. I like that the ingredients are minimal, although there is a very faint sulfur smell. It's not overwhelming , I only barely noticed it. Overall, I will keep this in my skincare drawer to use for acne spots.
Received the SOS treatment from Stellar Testing product panel and was very impressed. Size and redness were reduced after just the first use. My sensitive skin tolerated it well.

My acne always flares up every month, so I was so excited that the Stellar Product Testing Panel asked me to try out a spot corrector for my honest review! I started using the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector at night when I saw a few acne flare-ups, and I was very impressed with the results overnight! My acne noticeably improved by the next morning. It worked especially well for those annoying and painful red acne bumps, as they were completely gone in only 2 days after using this product. My go-to spot corrector has always been products with benzoyl peroxide because of of how quickly it works, but the huge down-side to benzoyl peroxide is that it bleaches fabrics. This was my first time trying a sulfur-based spot corrector. The Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector works just as quickly, and I had zero issues with bleaching! One of the side effects that I read about with the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector is dryness, but I did not experience any dryness during the 3 weeks that I have been using it so far. The only down-side with this sulfur medication is that it does have a faint sulfur smell. Therefore, I prefer to use the product at night. I did try this spot corrector once during the day, but I kept smelling the sulfur. With that being said, overall, I've been very happy with the quick results of this product without any side effects, and I plan on continuing to use this spot corrector nightly as needed!

The Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector is amazing. With mask acne, my face has been feeling like it's high school all over again. This spot corrector helped clear my acne spots up in 5 days. I love that this product is fragrance free. My skin is so sensitive and I did not have any issues with the ingredients. This product also has a B3 vitamin which helps with moisture loss! Another plus for dry skin. This product left my face feeling lightweight and free. It was not heavy on my face as other products have in the past. This little tube fell right in with my normal daily skin regimen and I highly recommend it to those needing a little boost in their facial routine. Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with this.

As someone who has dealt with my fair share of skin issues, I am always trying out new spot treatments, hoping to find the perfect one for my needs. I was excited when The Stellar Product Panel reached out and sent me the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector to test. It comes in very nice packaging including a tube to squeeze the product out and I appreciate the cleanliness factor of that. The main active ingredient in this spot treatment is sulfur. I've used sulfur treatments before that are very messy and slide all over and off my face. This is not the case with Vichy. This is a nice, thick cream that blends really well into the skin. If you use the right amount, you can't even tell it's there. After putting a small dab on overnight, in the morning, the blemish was definitely smaller. Not completely eliminated, but I could tell that the size went down. You can apply a couple of times a day and it didn't dry out my skin or cause any irritation. I definitely plan on using this for any other issues that pop up!

Thank you to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for giving me this opportunity to try Vichy Normaderm SOS Acne Rescue Spot Protector! I've been using this for 2 weeks now and I feel that it's been working great on my very sensitive skin! On the box it says to use 2x day but given my sensitivity, I've been using it once a day to start to ensure nothing crazy happened to my face. About a month before trying this I used entire acne regimen from a large name brand and my face turned so bright red and itchy I couldn't put anything on it for weeks. It was like a terrible chemical peel! This Normaderm SOS doesn't have any smell or cause any reaction when I place on my face. It doesn't go on fully clear so you do need to rub it in all the way but I haven't had a problem with this as I've done it as part of my nighttime routine. While I still have a few red spots on my face, overall I'm noticing a positive change since starting and no dry patches. I plan on trying to go to 2x a day to see if I can get a better result overall!

avis.titre: Cleared acne spots from mask use
avis.texte: I am in LOVE with this product! I had been struggling with acne for quite some time because of the frequent mask wearing and tried lots of washes and creams and nothing seemed to work. Over night I felt like my acne/acne spots were gone. I followed the directions and started only using it once a day in the evenings after washing my face. I then started to use it in the mornings too before applying my makeup. I feel like my face is really smooth now. I still get acne from wearing my mask, but I know with a couple dabs of Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector and it will clear up instantly. I would highly recommend it to anyone who needs acne spots gone quickly! It does cause a little bit of dry skin but I counteract that with a good moisturizer/sunscreen! I received this product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel in exchange for my honest review.

I received the product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel! I used this product every night before bed. I applied to clean dry skin. After night 4 I noticed blemishes start to clear up. I absolutely love the fact that it is a Dermatologist- grade formula. My skin is clear and I am so happy because it has been a insecurity of mine. Highly recommend

avis.titre: Gentle acne spot treatment, no salicylic acid
avis.texte: I received this product from the Stellar Product Testing Panel and was pleasantly surprised by how gentle and non-irritating this spot treatment was. My skin is sensitive and prone to redness but this light cream formula didn't dry it out or cause redness. I used it on two pimples. One was just starting next to my nose and I used the spot treatment overnight and the zit never got bigger. The second pimple was on my forehead. I've used it for two days now and the pimple hasn't gone away but seems to be shrinking and hasn't turned cystic like most of mine do in this area. This spot treatment isn't a miracle worker but is safe for those with sensitive skin and doesn't have a stinky smell. I like that the main ingredient is sulfur instead of benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid, which aren't recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. However, it does contain glycolic acid which some doctors don't recommend during pregnancy so best to check with your ob if you're expecting.

I LOVE this product. I was given this to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel. I'll be honest, I was super apprehensive about trying this. I have extremely sensitive skin and eczema. In the past, acne spot treatments have caused a lot of awful skin reactions because of the harsh chemicals and ingredients. I am so amazed by this product. Not only does this spot treatment take care of acne overnight, but it works perfectly with my sensitive skin! This formula is thick, but it absorbs into the skin really quickly. It leaves my skin feeling amazingly soft. I use this 2-3 times a week and my skin is so much clearer after each use. I'm in love and will definitely be investing in gallons of this.

After having babies, I feel like my skin is back in middle school with the more-than-occasional blemish. I have tried this corrector on a few trouble spots and I notice clear skin again within a couple of days. It does seem to reduce redness. That being said, I can't get over the sulfur smell. It's strong. As in, don't put it anywhere on your cheeks/upper lip/chin. You will smell it all day. Overall, I think it does the job, but I have a tough time overlooking the smell. Thank you so much to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for sending me this product to review.

If you are looking for a gentle blemish & acne topical, then look no further! I saw results after just one week of using the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector. Combining this with my normal cleansing routine was easy & I was impressed with how gentle the formula was. Often times with spot correctors, there is a burning sensation, but I didn't get any of that. Overall, this spot corrector is a great addition to my skincare routine and I am so glad I got a chance to try it out thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel.

As someone dealing with post-weaning breakouts and "maskne" I was really excited to try the Vichy spot corrector. I head able to use it for a few days, and noticed it really helped diminish some problem spots on my chin. I definitely plan to use this on future breakouts. It's a nice alternative to other chemicals and it didn't irritate my sensitive skin. Thanks to Stellar Product Testing Panel for letting me try this!

avis.titre: A gentle approach to spot treatment
avis.texte: I received the product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel and used it about twice per week on small blemishes. My favorite feature of this product is that it takes a non-harsh approach to blemish control. Using sulfur instead of harsher chemicals meant that I wasn't dealing with dried-out skin or bleached-out towels.

I really like this Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector--I have sensitive skin but still break out frequently. Normal acne treatments dry out my skin, so I rarely use it. But this corrector is gentle enough to not aggravate my skin while still fighting blemishes. It is expensive, but I also like that it doesn't have benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid as an ingredient--I'm currently pregnant so I am very careful with my skincare ingredients. I'm excited to try some other items from this line now. Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with this to review.

Thank you Stellar Product Testing Panel for allowing me to try Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector for free! After having about two weeks to test this product, I feel that it is very potent and effective. The directions list that it is possible to use this up to three times daily, but I found this completely unnecessary as I saw dramatic improvements after the initial use. I highly recommend this product with the caveat to use it wisely as it is powerful!

avis.titre: Excellent for getting rid of hormonal acne
avis.texte: So I used to have terrible acne. Finally, at 35 I have been able to limit it to just hormonal acne when my monthly visitor arrives. Now I just get these smaller pimples around that time. I used this product at night before bed. In just a couple nights it significantly reduced my acne. Most went away. I found this product to not be over drying like some salicylic acid products. I also used a good moisturizer while using it. I like that this could also be used during pregnancy. Salicylic acid, you have to be careful with how much you use while pregnant. I would recommend this to someone looking to spot treat acne. I received the product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel.

Thank you stellar panel for the opportunity to test this product! This spot corrector is all you need to get rid of unwanted acne on the spot. Since the pandemic, I have had "maskne" pop up on my face. After applying the spot corrector for two days my blemishes were gone! The natural ingredients were soft & gentle on my skin & didn't dry me out. If you want a great spot treatment that gets rid of acne on the spot- this is the product for you!

I have been struggling with maskne for awhile now and I was so thankful to receive this product from the Stellar Product Testing Panel. I saw major improvements after a week and now I use this as a spot corrector for the occasional blemish. The ingredients are great and dermatologist tested and it didn't irritate my sensitive skin. The smell wasn't my favorite but once I had worked it in I didn't even notice it. I would definitely recommend keeping this on hand for when you need a quick spot corrector.

I was given this to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel. I have a very angry skin right now and I am trying to find new acne products that work. So when I was offered to test this SOS cream, I was really excited! And it is different from what I used to use. I always use something with salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide. And it did work great on my skin, keeping angry pimples under somewhat of a control. I even used this spot corrector as a thin layer after a moisturizer on affected area. And it did help a little. Big plus, you dont look like you have war paint on your face when you use it like some other products do. The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because it didnt clear out my breakouts completely, but worked as a spot treatment very well. So, at the end, I would recommend this cream, and even thinking about purchasing it when this tube runs out!

I have used the spot corrector for the past few weeks and noticed a difference in my blemishes! Reduced redness, less swelling and clearer skin. I have VERY sensitive skin and loving this product so far! Thankful to have found this product after receiving it as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel!

I've never had chronic acne, but I've struggled with breakouts or the sudden appearance of a monster zit since I was a teen (I'm 30 now). I'm a popper... which always makes it worse so I'm trying to stop. I received this spot treatment from the Stellar Product Testing Panel and I'm super happy with it. I will buy it again when it runs out... in the distant future. I barely use any to treat each zit or almost zit so it will last at least a year I'd guess. The best part about it is that it dries almost clean instead of white, so I can use it in the mornings as well as at night and leave it on my skin. I notice it because I know it's there, but I doubt anyone else would notice. It's not a miracle paste and doesn't clear zits overnight, but I can visibly see a difference in the size 12ish hours after I use it every time without fail. Small zits clear in about 2-3 days. When I have a zit, I absolutely HAVE to do something about it, so having this spot corrector helps me treat it and resist popping. Overall, it doesn't work miracles but it very obviously works with every use, so that's a two thumbs up from me.

This Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector was gentle and quick acting! It contains 10% sulfur and dries up blemishes quickly. I had a few red spots and I used this spot corrector on overnight and saw an immediate difference the next morning. This was super gentle, felt great on my skin and cleared the blemishes. I used this corrector anytime a blemish appeared and it did not dry my skin out. I highly recommend this product. I received this product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel

I used this spot corrector 5 times since receiving it. This product did not dry out my skin as on the spot acne treatments have in the past. I have sensitive skin, so i am always hesitant to try new products at first. This product worked quickly once I saw a pimple start to appear. Within a day or two the spot was clear. I like that sulfur is used as I have tried a face wash in the past with that ingredient and liked it. This product fits into my skin regimen perfectly, I will continue use it for this S.O.S moments. I received this product as a part of the stellar product testing panel.

I am very picky when it comes to my skincare, so when I received this little green tube from the Stellar Product Testing Panel, I was nervous. My skin can be unpredictable. At 31, I still struggle with acne on occasion. During the winter, redness and dry patches are my worst enemies. So I have my tried and true team of toner, serums, hyaluronic acid, moisturizer and my beloved retinol to keep my skin happy. But I don't have a spot treatment. They usually fail me—too harsh, leading to drying/peeling and irritation which inevitably leads to another breakout....exactly what I was trying to get rid of! Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector has done none of that for me, thankfully! I've had the opportunity to use it a couple of times now, and I've been pleasantly surprised! My sensitive skin has not reacted, at all, no matter how often I apply it (it recommends 1-3 times per day, but beginning with once per day and moving up to avoid any dryness). A very tiny dab of it goes a long way, and I love that the tube is made specifically to only dispense a teeny amount. Though it is a sulfur based spot treatment, it does not smell strongly of sulfur. One of the blemishes I used it on happened to be on the tip of my nose (thanks maskne....) and I did not find the smell at all unpleasant. I experienced no redness or drying, and the blemishes cleared quickly, typically within a day. And it seems to help them to heal faster too. My skin likes to hold on to the red mark where the

avis.titre: Easy to use and very effective
avis.texte: I don't get a ton of acne, but wearing a mask has definitely caused some issues. I got this acne rescue from Stellar Product Testing Panel and I noticed a difference the next day, The little bumps I had were almost completely flat, after the next day, they were gone. It takes a bit longer on larger pimples and doesn't seem to do too much when the skin is broken or when a pimple has popped, but it works incredibly well on those early bumps.

Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for sending me this product to try out! I'm definitely someone who is prone to zits and I was seriously impressed with how quickly this stuff reduced redness. I noticed a big difference in just a few days! And the best part was it didn't dry my skin out like other products I've used in the past. This will definitely be something I buy again. My only complaint is the price, but it's worth it to me to spend a little more on something that's quality, especially when it comes to skin care!

avis.titre: Good, but the smell is horrible
avis.texte: I have struggled with acne for over 10 years and this is the first spot treatment I've tried that didnt make my sensitive skin burn and it actually did something. I applied it at night on a few huge red pimples i had and by morning they were smaller and less red. However, i HATED the smell, i could smell it the whole time i was trying to fall asleep and i just could not ignore it. Which makes me not want to use it again but I love the simple ingredients and it actually works, so I'll probably try to see if i get used to the smell. Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with this .

After using this spot corrector for several weeks, I have seen so much positive change in my skin! I suffer from moderate acne with frequent outbreaks. I also have very sensitive skin. The Vichy Spot Corrector works great for this type of skin. I used it every night for three weeks. First off, I have noticed that my face is much smoother/softer when I wake up in the morning. Secondly, my breakouts are less inflamed and redness is not as obvious as previously. I feel really good about using this product as the ingredients are safe for my sensitive skin (Maximum Strength 10% Sulfur, Niacinamide & Glycolic Acid). Despite having Sulfur, I don't feel like the smell is overwhelming in the product like I have noticed in other products. I was reassured to see that it was approved by dermatologists. I had no problems with redness or inflammation from this product. I love how soft my skin feels. This has definitely earned a spot in my acne regimen! Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with this.

I received this product to try from the Stellar Product Testing Panel. It worked well for me on a few small blemishes - I haven't had a really large pimple to test it on yet. But after only one overnight application on a small blemish it was significantly smaller in the morning. I did not notice any issues with my skin drying out. I'm happy with the product so far and will continue using it.

What I loved most about this acne spot corrector is that it went on light and was still very effective! I used it 4 times a week for two weeks and noticed that it helped my acne spot heal really fast! I loved that it didn't dry out my skin (I used it once a day as recommended for first time users)! I was given this to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel.

I was given this to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel. I break out every month due to PMSing and until now I have never been able to find anything to really help. I put this on my break out spots before I go to bed and when I wake up they are almost completely gone! After using it one more time all my break outs clear up completely. It works amazingly! I was a little worried it might dry out my skin but I have found that my skin is just as hydrated and moisturized as before. I have a horrible habit of popping my break outs and picking at my face and this stuff has really saved me!

I received this product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel. I used the spot corrector for 3 days in a row three times a day as suggested by the manufacturer and once a day after on my problematic areas until it cleared up. It really is a nice product. I have been breaking out alot around my chin from all the mask wearing and this helped clear up my chin with the days. It does state it may dry up your skin, but so far I has not. It glides on easily and a little dab goes a long way. The only thing I didn't like was the smell. It doesn't have a pleasant smell and it can turn some people off that is why I gave it a 4 star only. Other than that, this spot corrector is something I would recommend to others who are dealing with acne issues.

After using this spot corrector for several weeks, I have seen so much positive change in my skin! I suffer from moderate acne with frequent outbreaks. I also have very sensitive skin. The Vichy Spot Corrector works great for this type of skin. I used it every night for three weeks. First off, I have noticed that my face is much smoother/softer when I wake up in the morning. Secondly, my breakouts are less inflamed and redness is not as obvious as previously. I feel really good about using this product as the ingredients are safe for my sensitive skin (Maximum Strength 10% Sulfur, Niacinamide & Glycolic Acid). Despite having Sulfur, I don't feel like the smell is overwhelming in the product like I have noticed in other products. I was reassured to see that it was approved by dermatologists. I had no problems with redness or inflammation from this product. I love how soft my skin feels. This has definitely earned a spot in my acne regimen! Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with this.

I was able to use this product twice (same time but 2 different locations). I liked that it has a cream texture and was absorbed without residue- only took a tiny amount! It seemed to dry out the blemish within hours but 24-48 hours have a scab (definitely smaller than "picking" at the spot); it hasn't been long enough for me to comment on days or weeks follow up. The ingredients are to be expected with dermatologist grade products, although the only downside is I could smell the sulfur on the blemish near my nose when I first put it on, but it didn't last too long. I absolutely love that it seems to start working immediately and did not require reapplication! Thank you to Stellar Product Testing Panel for giving me this product to review; a keeper for sure!

avis.titre: Great product to have on hand
avis.texte: The Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector is a great product to have on hand for those annoying pop-up acne that can plague you out of nowhere. I tend to get acne and blemishes when it's that time of month and I grabbed this product and started using it once a day as soon as I got my first acne flare-ups. It didn't erase the pimples overnight but I feel that it drastically reduced the size and redness of my pimples which was great. I do feel that it took the acne away faster than if I hadn't done anything. The product felt great on my skin and didn't have an overwhelming fragrance which is so important to me. I will definitely keep it on hand and use it because it really did make a difference and I think it's because it has true dermatologist grade active ingredients instead of just filler stuff. I received this product to review as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel.

I have extremely sensitive skin. I switch up one item in my beauty routine and my face breaks out. So as you can imagine, adding a mask to my daily routine...maskne. Bad. I'm 36 years old and I didn't even have acne this bad in high school. So when asked to sample Vichy from Stellar Testing Panel, I was like "can't get any worse let's at least try." I could feel two of those gigantic zits coming. The big ones under the surface on my chin you could feel for weeks. So I used my Vichy, and within 2-3 days, they went away! They never even broke the surface. Using Vichy, I finally feel my maskne is under control and I feel like myself again!

I was given this to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel. I've been suffering from hormonal acne the last year and a half, and things are finally calming down with my skin, but I still have at least one breakout a week, if not more. I haven't found anything that works very good as a spot corrector until I started using this. It heals acne faster than anything I've tried and it doesn't seem to have the "scar" as long either. I'm very pleased thus far and will keep it in my rotation. I also like that it has dermatologist-grade ingredients.

I used this spot corrector 5 times total since receiving it. This product made my skin feel moisturized when usually when I have used a zit zapper in the past it has dried me out and not even worked. This product worked quickly and helped with the pain of the zit as well. I think the ingredients were interesting since normally I've used zit creams with harsh ingredients. I think since this works, there's no need to use multiple dermatologist medications I've been prescribed. My favorite part of using this product was that it didn't dry out my face and it worked! I received this product as a part of the stellar product testing panel.

I'm a teacher and have to use a mask all day while working from the classroom. So my mouth area is my new trouble spot. This worked like a charm to clean up small zits that appeared over night. One dab in the area at night time and they were gone the next morning! My skin looks better than ever now. It's not a cakey feeling cream and it doesn't leave flakes as it dries of. Which is probably favorite feature! It feels so natural to the skin you could probably get away with wearing it during the day! My skin looked flawless after using this a couple of times. I had bad acne in my teens so I know exactly what helps my skin heal from pesky zits so I was so excited to see that the ingredients were dermatologists recommended and so was the brand. I love finding products with ingredients that actually work and aren't just labeled dermatologist friendly. I'm even more excited that this product works wonders! Thank you Stellar product testing panel for giving me exactly what I didn't know I needed.

I love finding products with ingredients that actually work and aren't just labeled dermatologist friendly. I'm even more excited that this product works wonders! Thank you Stellar product testing panel for giving me exactly what I didn't know I needed.

I received this product through the Stellar Product Testing panel. It came at the perfect time, as I was going through a hormonal breakout like no other and I was stoked to give it a shot. Sadly, I was underwhelmed by the effectiveness, though there were several positive attributes. First, this was not a miracle overnight correcting product. It did help to dry up some deeper blemishes, but took several days. However, the cream went on smoothly and rubbed in perfectly. It wasn't cakey or pastey. I had no irritation/burning/tingling like I have had with other products. There was no significant odor, and it didn't stain or discolor my towel. The tube is the perfect size to fit on my countertop cup of cosmetics. I WANT to love it, but I'm just not sure that I do. I'll continue using for a few more weeks to get a full hormonal cycle completed so I may update later.

I have used this spot corrector for 5 nights in a row. I had a few acne spots in varying stages, one that was relatively new, one that was on its way toward healing over, and one that was basically gone but still noticeably pink. Based on my usual healing times without using any products, this spot corrector noticeably sped up the process for the spots that were already healing. However, I did not feel that it made much of a difference for the one that was new, until it had begun to go down. I would definitely keep using this product to speed up the healing process of spots that have begun to recede, but would likely use a stronger product to kill the fresh ones. This product was not greasy, spread thinly and evenly, and was not overly drying on my sensitive skin. This gives it an advantage over the stronger products, so the one-two-punch is likely to become part of my repertoire to get rid of spots as quickly and gently as possible. I received this product as a member of the Stellar Product Testing Panel.

Weirdly I am getting postpartum acne that harkens back to my teenage days and I'm not a fan. What I am a fan of is this spot corrector that I was able to dab on the breakouts before bed and it dried them up by morning. No extra dryness or redness. It turned what would have been 2-3 day zits into 1-day ones and for that I am grateful. I was delighted to test this product as part of the Stellar Testing Panel.

avis.titre: Reduces blemishes quickly but strong smell
avis.texte: I was given the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector from the Stellar Product Testing Panel and was excited to try it. I'm 39 and yet still have quite a few breakouts, especially with all the mask wearing that's happening these days. I was glad to see that it has dermatologist-grade active ingredients. I used it once a day as there was a caution on the instructions that it could be irritating or over-drying and since I have sensitive skin, I was careful. I found that it did not over-dry my skin or irritate it which was great. It did a good job of reducing my blemishes quickly and I liked that it didn't lead to discoloration or bleaching of my pillowcase like some other acne products I've used. The one drawback is that it does have a strong smell of sulphur, so much so, that I had to stop using it around my nose where I often have breakouts. I think this is a high-quality product and works well to reduce acne but may not be as good of a choice for those of us with sensitive noses.

This spot corrector worked quickly but was not overly drying. I have used benzoyl peroxide products before but they over dry my skin and bleach all my sheets and towels. This product works well without the unwanted side effects of other spot creams. Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with this .

avis.titre: Gentle on my skin, helps reduce redness
avis.texte: Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with Vichy Normaderm's S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector. After the birth of my third child I have been dealing with blemishes and breakouts. I typically use facial masks and default to toothpaste to help heal my blemishes but this didn't seem to be doing much so I was eager to try this product. The directions say it can be applied up to three times a day but I only started with once a day. I didn't notice any irritation with my skin. It did seem to help heal my blemishes but it was not overnight. It took a few days. I plan to try it more than once a day on my next blemish. The smell is pretty mild and not bothersome. It was gentle on my skin and did help remove blemishes. I was having ones under my skin that you couldn't see but I could feel and those seem to be cleared up. My skin looks a bit clearer. I liked the product and will keep using it on future blemishes, it beats toothpaste!

I received vichy normaderm acne rescue spot corrector through stellar product testing panel and the product contains 3 main ingredients which is sulfur, niacin-amide and glycolic acid. With that being said these 3 ingredients helped my skin a lot as my acne was getting bad due to wearing masks with a 12 hour long shift at work so sulfur helped me in reducing the acne blemishes, niacin-amide helped retain the moisture and glycolic acid is known for its brightening agent which made my uneven and dull skin look cleaner and brighter. I am very happy that I got selected to try this product as I really needed some help with my acne prone face.

avis.titre: Arrived just in time and works well so far!
avis.texte: I've been using the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector for about a week now. It arrived just in time for my monthly break out. Whoever told me that acne goes away after your teen years has a lot to answer for! At 37 years old, my acne has been getting worse and worse since my second baby was born. Every month like clockwork, here it comes. Therefore, I was very excited to get to test this product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel. I need to use it for a bit longer before I'll be able to give a 5 star review but it does seem to work so far. It's not the magic pill I've always dreamed of that will 100% cure my acne but it's a relief to have while I wait for magic to become real. It works especially well on small pimples that are just forming. I noticed that for blemishes that were more established, it brought them to a head overnight and then they quickly healed from there. I had one large, stubborn pimple that this was not able to get rid of but I do think it helped reduce the size. I only use the S.O.S. Spot Corrector once a day since it's winter and I don't want to risk drying out my skin too much. Once a day application did not over-dry my skin at all so next time I might try applying it twice a day to any particularly stubborn blemishes. I like that it is non-comedogenic, oil-free, paraben-free and fragrance-free. I don't have particularly sensitive skin but have had some irritation with other treatments so I'm happy to report no negative side effect

I was impressed how well this spot corrector works on my face. It has helped me get through a bad pregnancy hormone induced breakout. If you're considering trying it, go for it! You won't be disappointed. I was happy to receive this product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel.

avis.titre: Lovely product, struggled with the scent
avis.texte: After unboxing the lovely packaging and opening the tube, the first thing I noticed about the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S Acne Rescue Spot Corrector was the scent. There is no doubt that sulfur is the active ingredient. I have a sensitive sense of smell and for me the sulfur smell was very strong and lingered after application. I primarily struggle with hormonal acne around my hairline and chin and found that the product did speed up the healing process. Unfortunately for me, the effectiveness of the product doesn't outweigh the strong odor so it will be reserved for the worst blemishes. The feel of the product is really nice, it is light on the skin and absorbs really well. It is easy to apply concealer or other makeup on top of it. I didn't experience dryness issues using the product which can sometimes happen with a spot corrector. I was also really impressed with the amount of product, you can get a lot of use out of a single tube. Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for sending me the product to try!

avis.titre: Noticed improvement within a couple of days
avis.texte: I've had issues with acne popping up in the past and have tried many products. Nothing had worked so I was excited to receive a sample through Stellar Product Testing Panel. I used it twice a day and within a couple days I noticed improvement and then my acne was gone within about 10 days. What I also like about it was that it wasn't heavy or greasy. It also didn't burn like others I have used. I will continue using Vichy Spot Corrector and will recommend it to others.

I'm luckily having a good stretch of skin (thank you pregnancy), but I have the occasional maskne flare up. When a patch seems to be breaking through, I apply the Vichy cream at night and it's like it wasn't even there in the morning. My skin did appear a bit dried out, but as it's winter in the Midwest my skin is super dry anyway. This cream did the trick amazingly without any crazy reactions. It's so nice knowing I have a tool to stop breakouts before they become out of control! I received this as a part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel (and I'm SO glad I did).

Thanks to the Stellar Product Testing Panel for providing me with this product to review. I've been using this acne spot treatment on my spots for the past few weeks and am pleasantly surprised! My skin is quite sensitive and usually gets really dried out and flakey when I use other spot treatments. This helped tremendously with clearing up spots without drying out the skin around it. Like many people, all this mask-wearing is leading to a lot more spots than normal for me, so I appreciate a treatment that works effectively but also is gentle. I've been applying it for overnight use and that has seemed adequate to clear up my existing spots. It seems to help prevent new spots from flaring up too badly, as well.

I received this product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel, and couldn't be happier! I struggle with blackheads on my nose, and occasional red spots through a very oily t-zone, but the rest of my skin is dry. This product was amazing on both zones of my face, and got the job done, fast! I've tried many things on my nose, and it either doesn't work, or works but is so irritating I look like Rudolph after I use it. The first (and best) test was using it on my nose. I applied it before bed, and the next morning I already noticed a difference in the size of my pores and the amount of blackheads. After a week, my nose looked better than it ever has! And best of all, no red nose, irritation or tight feeling with my skin. I love the sulfur/niacinamide combination over salicylic acid, the sulfur does an amazing job of cleaning out my problem areas, while the niacinamide helps with the skin recovery. I use it every day and have not suffered from irritation. I plan on scaling back use now that my blackheads are under control, but will still use it to maintain the results.
So happy I received this cream! It really helped my blemishes overnight!

I was given this product to try as part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel. I was excited to try the acne spot corrector since I have been suffering from "maskne" due to constant mask wearing. The cream was smooth and not at all greasy! It was completely fragrance free. I started using the cream once a day. After a few days, I had not seen any improvement in my skin but it also wasn't causing dry skin so I decided to start using it twice a day. Once I began using it twice a day, I saw a slight improvement. For the occasional blemish this cream would be helpful.

This spot treatment dries up acne quickly without irritation. My zits were gone in 24 hours and so was the inflammation. Typically spot treatments irritate my skin because of BPO or they are ineffective so it's great to find something that works. This will be a permanent staple in my acne arsenal. FYI it does have a sulfur scent to it. It's not an issue for me but if you are super sensitive to smells it may be offensive.
